 Memphis Grizzlies caught enemy Golden State Warriors in enemy territory.
 Memphis beat Golden State 111-108 in an away game at the Chase Center in San Francisco, California on the 24th (Korea Standard Time). With this victory, he won two consecutive games since the opening. Golden State has lost two games in a row.
 In the first half, Golden State chased Memphis when it ran away. Golden State immediately caught up with Memphis early in the first quarter as it ran to an eight-point gap with the physical dominance. Brandin Pozemski led the team's offense with four attempts in the first quarter, all of them successful.
 사진 확대 Memphis overpowered Golden State. Photo = Getty Images/AFP= Courtesy of Yonhap News Memphis led 54-41 with 4:40 left in the second quarter to take the lead, but Golden State caught up again this time. He induced an opponent's foul, getting 15 free throws in the second quarter alone and making 13 of them. Rookie Yaxel Rendenberg scored nine points in the second quarter alone, boosting his energy.
 On the contrary, Memphis struggled with the game even before the end of the first half, with three players in foul trouble with four fouls. At the end of the first half, the score was narrowed to four points, 60-56.
 Memphis hit again early in the third quarter. Ty Jerome's performance stood out. After scoring only eight points until the first half, he scored eight points in 2:15 of the third quarter. With 9:45 left, Jerome and Rendenborg collided, leading to a confrontation between the two teams. Both players were given technical fouls side by side. Jerome was not daunted. Following the score, he led the game by inducing the opponent's attacker to foul during the defense process.
 Golden State didn't just suffer, either. After the opposing starting members entered the bench, their defensive concentration revived and narrowed the gap back to the chasing right. While Memphis faltered due to shooting difficulties and turnovers, Rendenberg scored consecutive points, narrowing the gap to 84-83 with 2:49 left in the third quarter.
 사진 확대 Memphis took Golden State. Photo = AP= Courtesy of Yonhap News With 2:07 left, Pozemski hit a 3-pointer after a few offensive attempts to take the lead for the first time since the beginning of the second quarter. Finished the third quarter with a 90-84 lead.
 Golden State took the early lead for the first time in the game in the fourth quarter. They did not overwhelm Memphis, but showed enough performance to keep the lead. Rendenberg's 3-pointer and Pozemski's score went in succession, widening the gap to 103-92 with 5:18 left.
 The two teams, which scored close to 90 points until the third quarter, struggled in the fourth quarter side by side with the offense.
 Memphis was the first team to wake up from the turbulence. Cameron Booser made all of the free throws obtained by the opponent's defensive foul following Pozemski's turnovers with 1:49 left, and Jerome made a 3-pointer in the ensuing attack, making it 106-105 with 1:24 left, again a point difference.
 사진 확대 Golden State has been mired in a two-game losing streak since the opening. Photo = Courtesy of San Francisco Chronicle via AP= Yonhap News In Golden State, Curry and Pozemski's outside shots went off the rim one after another in a close game. Memphis, on the other hand, led 108-106 when the buzzer scored with 20 seconds left.
 Golden State sought the last chance to attack, but Draymond Green's attacker foul was declared with 12.8 seconds left and missed the last chance. Memphis virtually confirmed its victory with Jerome making an additional free throw followed by a steal and a score.
 For Memphis, Jerome had 28 points and 5 assists, Boozer had 25 points and 13 rebounds, and E-Day had 8 points and 10 rebounds.
 In Golden State, Curry scored 24 points, Rendenberg scored 18 points, 13 rebounds, and Pozemski scored 18 points, but the color faded.
 [San Francisco (USA) = KIM JAE HO, MK Sports Correspondent]
